title: mentha suaveolens subsp. timija
intro: Mentha suaveolens subsp. timija, commonly known as Bois de Timija or Indian Oregano, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family. It is a perennial herb that has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, alleviate respiratory problems, and protect against various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Mentha suaveolens subsp. timija include timosaponins, timosaponin B5, timosaponin B7, and timosaponin B9, among others, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against oxidative stress, making it a valuable natural remedy in traditional medicine.
